goodsServices.description: (1) Computer programs (downloadable software) for designing and creating digital drawings for use in construction, 3d animation, automotive design, industrial product design; computer software for creating 3d virtual reality plan and technical specifications for use in construction, automotive, and industrial product design; computer software for computer-aided design (CAD); computer programs in the form of geographical information systems

(1) Data communication services, namely, provision of electronic data interchange services; worldwide computer network access services; providing access to and leasing access time to computer databases; provision of access to web pages; wireless digital messaging services 
(2) Education in the implementation and use of data processing programs for designing and creating digital drawings and models; training services relating to computer-aided engineering design; education services relating to computer software, and hardware systems for use in construction, 3d animation, automotive design and industrial product design 
(3) Software development, programming and implementation; design, maintenance and updating of computer programs and computer systems for creating digital drawings and models; computer aided graphic design; computer aided design services relating to building projects; computer aided design services; computer help desk consultancy, advisory and information services; consultancy relating to computer programs for designing and creating digital drawings and models; engineering consultancy relating to design, software as a service [SaaS] services featuring software for designing and creating digital drawings for use in construction, for creating 3d virtual reality plans and technical specifications for use in construction and for computer-aided design (cad) in the field of construction; none of the aforementioned services in the field of multichannel communications and print and mail
